messages:
tia: Quick note 1: Product wants to deprecate alias `model-alpha` in ~3 weeks. Need migration doc + tiny code helpers. Who can own samples?
omar: I'll take node + curl. Ben, can you do python and the migration page?
ben: Yep. Two asks: 1) include alias->model table (primary + q4), 2) show param rename helper (some teams still use `input`). Keep it short.

docs-bot: Added checklist item: update sample-app snippets, add redirect, add changelog blurb. Assigned to @omar and @ben.

tia: Example helper for node streaming (for docs):
```js
// accept legacy `input` or new `prompt`
function pickPrompt(body) { return body.prompt ?? body.input; }
```
Use this in sample endpoints.
omar: For curl examples I'll show before/after: `-d '{"model":"model-alpha","input":"hi"}'` -> `-d '{"model":"rw-instruct-v2","prompt":"hi"}'`. Also include alias map snippet: `{'model-alpha':'rw-instruct-v2','model-alpha-q':'rw-instruct-v2-q4'}`.

ben: I'll add a rollback note: if issues, re-create alias for 48h and flip docs banner to "deprecated but active". Pushed branch `docs/deprecate-model-alpha`. PR soon.
tia: Timeline: review by Tue, merge Wed to give 2 weeks notice. Thanks. :thumbsup:
